records.part: Procurement of up to twelve (12) AH-64E Apache Attack Helicopter aircraft, including remanufacture and obsolescence mitigation for critical electronic components
records.reason: The Boeing Company is the sole designer, developer, manufacturer, and system integrator of the AH-64 Apache aircraft.

records.part: Management and mitigation of obsolescence for critical electronic components, including redesign and qualification efforts
records.reason: The technical scope includes the remanufacture of up to 12 Apache aircraft, and management and mitigation of obsolescence for critical electronic components, including redesign and qualification efforts.
